items.title: Group work is one switch
items.line: Every question card, whiteboard and artifact now has the same "Students work: Individual · Group" control.
items.screenshot: A question card set to Group, with the options row showing

items.title: No surprise team reveals
items.line: "Run as Group" is now "Show teams to students", and publishing as a group with teams hidden asks you first.
items.screenshot: The "Students can't see teams yet…" confirm with its two buttons

items.title: End Class adds, never replaces
items.line: Participation credit goes on top of points you gave by hand, and ending twice doesn't count it twice.

items.title: Export class results to CSV
items.line: A new "Export results (CSV)" button on the Participation tab downloads every saved answer, with names, for marking.
items.screenshot: The Participation toolbar with the Export button

items.title: Hidden names stay hidden
items.line: In Responses & points, each student keeps one number all class, the Class List blurs, and ticks stay put.
items.screenshot: The Responses window with names hidden and the blurred Class List behind it

items.title: One join code per class
items.line: A double-click on Run Live Class, or a second tab, no longer splits the class across two codes.

items.title: Long decimals marked correctly
items.line: In a numeric question's live answer chart, keys like 3.14159 now mark the full key correct, not a rounded one.
items.screenshot: The answer bars for a 3.14159 key
